title: Vibrant Charred Kenyan Chestnut Mushroom Skewers
description: A low-glycemic Kenyan dish featuring charred chestnut mushrooms, this recipe is perfect for a solo dinner, with a focus on salt-bake and crisp texture. The combination of flavors and textures creates a truly vibrant dish.

ingredients.name: chestnut mushrooms
ingredients.notes: stem removed and caps sliced 1/2 inch thick

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated mushrooms onto skewers, leaving a small space between each mushroom.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the mushrooms are charred and crispy.
Brush the mushrooms with lemon juice during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
